kapak.alt: A simple but valuable case history question

youtube.baslik: Which ear do you hold the phone to? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Most people unknowingly use their better-hearing ear on the phone. In the case history, this simple question gives a useful clue even when the patient reports no difference between the ears.
